title: Chest radiograph learning estimates invasively measured filling pressure
summary: A VGG16-based regression network estimated pulmonary artery wedge pressure from chest radiographs in 936 cardiovascular patients. In 188 held-out patients, estimates correlated moderately with catheter measurements (r = 0.62), with wide agreement limits around plus or minus 11 mmHg and underestimation at high pressures. This clinical measurement study does not establish catheter replacement, prognosis or improved care.

source_review.scope: Primary relevant model Methods, Results and limitations; exact primary identity and current primary PubMed correction/retraction relationships checked.

evidence.tested: Separate 188-patient internal test against right-heart catheter pressure, after model tuning within the 748-patient development set.
evidence.unknown: External clinical utility remains unestablished; radiographs and catheter measurements were not simultaneous, high pressures were underestimated and several lung/device conditions were excluded.
evidence.ai_role: A transfer-learned convolutional network regresses radiograph features onto measured pulmonary artery wedge pressure.
